title: Our response to the Axios developer tool compromise
author: OpenAI / Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: OpenAI responds to the Axios supply chain attack by rotating macOS code signing certificates, updating apps, and confirming no user data was compromised....
body:
OpenAI responds to the Axios supply chain attack by rotating macOS code signing certificates, updating apps, and confirming no user data was compromised.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [OpenAI News](https://openai.com/index/axios-developer-tool-compromise).

Stay tuned to [Modelverse](https://www.themodelverse.in) for real-time model analysis and benchmark coverage.
